description: Independent Mandarin Grove speech pilot: 40 distinct characters, 12 alternate readings, and 15 short connected-speech prompts. Pinyin is lexical; fluent reviewers should allow natural sandhi and regional variants.

cases.meaning: The puppy is at the door.
cases.notes: Compare g/k in 狗 and 口; consecutive third tones may change naturally.

cases.pinyin: qǐng zài zhè lǐ tíng zhǐ
cases.notes: Listen for the intended third-tone 止; a low or half third tone need not have a full dip.
满 is third tone; 了 is neutral.

cases.pinyin: wǒ lí xué xiào hěn jìn
cases.meaning: I am close to the school.
cases.notes: 离 should be lí, with a clear l initial.
假 uses jià in this context.

cases.pinyin: zhè ge gù shì shì jiǎ de
cases.notes: 假 uses jiǎ; 个 and 的 may be unstressed.
Third-tone sequences need fluent-speaker judgment; lexical tones are shown.

cases.pinyin: wǒ men fēn chéng xiǎo zǔ
cases.notes: 组 and 祖 are homophones. Do not treat identical audio as a character error.

cases.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhǐ shì lǜ sè de
cases.meaning: This sheet of paper is green.
cases.notes: Compare zh in 纸 and ü in 绿.

cases.pinyin: wǒ yào mǎi shū bù mài shū
cases.meaning: I want to buy books, not sell them.
cases.notes: Contrast 买/卖; 不 before fourth tone normally changes to second tone.

cases.pinyin: tā shì wǒ de nǚ ér
cases.notes: Check ü in 女; connected-word timing can differ from isolated 女.
乐 uses yuè in 音乐. Third-tone sandhi in 我喜欢 is acceptable.

cases.pinyin: zhè ge hái zi zhǎng gāo le
cases.notes: 长 uses zhǎng; 子 is neutral in 孩子 although its isolated reading is zǐ.

cases.pinyin: wǒ bǎ shū huán gěi nǐ
cases.meaning: I return the book to you.
cases.notes: 还 uses huán. Third-tone changes are natural.

cases.pinyin: nǐ hǎo wǒ men yī qǐ dú shū ba
cases.notes: 你好 usually has second/third tone; 一 in 一起 normally changes to fourth tone. Shown pinyin is lexical.
